statement: National energy statistics, shown for context. Five countries and one theatre are systematically monitored for qualifying disruptions; every other country appears here only for national context and has no disruption record on this site.
not_scoring: These figures never change what counts as a disruption, never weight one and never rank one.

source.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration, International Energy Statistics
source.licence: U.S. government work; EIA's bulk file states no copyright on these series (copyright field: None).
source.attribution: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, International Energy Statistics.
source.update_cadence: annual, with a monthly oil series; refreshed by an analyst, never by the daily build

comparison_year_reason: The latest year EIA publishes across production, consumption, gas, coal and electricity. Oil runs one year later and is shown only on a country's own page.

total_production.label: Total primary energy production
total_production.definition: EIA total energy production: coal, natural gas, petroleum and other liquids, nuclear, and renewables and other, in one energy unit.

total_consumption.label: Total primary energy consumption
total_consumption.definition: EIA total energy consumption, in one energy unit.

prod_oil.label: Production from petroleum and other liquids

oil_production.label: Oil production
oil_production.definition: EIA petroleum and other liquids production: crude oil with lease condensate, natural gas plant liquids, other liquids and refinery processing gain. Wider than crude oil alone.

crude_production.label: Crude oil production
crude_production.definition: EIA crude oil including lease condensate.

oil_consumption.label: Oil consumption
oil_consumption.definition: EIA petroleum and other liquids consumption.

coal_production.label: Coal production
coal_production.definition: EIA coal production by mass, all ranks; a tonne of lignite and a tonne of hard coal count alike.

coal_consumption.label: Coal consumption
coal_consumption.definition: EIA coal consumption by mass, all ranks.

electricity_generation.label: Electricity generation
electricity_generation.definition: EIA net electricity generation, all sources.
